headline: Wireless systems.
Connected futures.
intro: We explore the technologies that connect our world. From high-frequency devices to intelligent networks, WiSyNet brings wireless research to life at Politecnico di Milano.
about: WiSyNet — Wireless System Networks — is a research laboratory funded under the RESTART programme. Based at the Department of Electronics, Information and Bioengineering (DEIB), we connect ideas, people and experiments to explore the future of wireless communication.

research.title: High-frequency technologies
research.text: Exploring mmWave and sub-THz devices, radio systems and component characterisation.

research.title: Intelligent wireless networks
research.text: Investigating open radio architectures, smart radio environments and massive connectivity.

research.title: Connected environments
research.text: Studying vehicular connectivity, experimental 5G networks and electromagnetic exposure.
